fields.description:
Event is from 7:00 pm to 8:30 pm at the DC Liberation Center:

337 H St NE, Washington, DC 20002

https://share.google/0l84yW9srAJdSs917

Here's the conversation guide for this week. You can determine your level by reading it and seeing which most fits your level of speaking:

Club de Conversación - 29 - Las Fronteras y la Libertad de Movimiento - Google Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VGEgz89WJujUGf0J5wtPXmBkqDZ3QePvMUIMQLWH-ks/edit

Keep practicing between sessions on our Discord: https://discord.gg/HuefQSfHVm

Please help support the space! You can donate at their website below:
DC Liberation Center | Join the Movement Today: https://www.dcliberationcenter.org/

Get weekly reminders and see every event: follow us on Luma, https://luma.com/spanishclubforsocialists
